outcome_meanings.zero: The target did not strictly outrank every distractor, including ties.
outcome_meanings.one: The target strictly outranked every distractor.

question.instructions: Will the target system assign the intended target a strictly higher choice score than every distractor for this item?

criteria.true: The intended target receives a strictly greater score than every distractor under the original forced-choice comparison.
criteria.false: At least one distractor receives an equal or greater score than the intended target; ties do not count as success.

evidence.review_notes: Reviewed response_scale and all three distinct verifier variants: lex-lwl, lex-viz_vocab, and gram-trog. They share the strict target-versus-all-distractors rule. This is a ranking event rather than generic generated-answer matching.

limitations: Many items require images; the current text-only adapter receives image references without the image bytes.
The stored observations are derived from released comparison scores rather than a reconstructed full historical API transcript.
